# Grok 1.0.5 identity

Frozen against installed and npm `@xai-official/grok@1.0.5`. Dist-tag `alpha`
`1.0.6` is ignored. Handshake evidence is initialize, `cached_token`
headless authenticate, and `session/new` with no provider prompt. Session
ids and account metadata are not retained. The `1.0.4` corpus stays.
